name: mashumaro-composable-serialization-strategy-ab20
instr:
Add reusable, immutable `SerializationPipeline` values that compose supported strategies into one conversion contract for dataclass fields and standalone `BasicEncoder` and `BasicDecoder` codecs. Existing callers that do not use pipelines must observe no change.

Every pipeline serializes in declaration order and deserializes in exact reverse order, including pass-through steps, while generic type arguments are concretized at every intermediate boundary. Directional callable annotations, including resolvable postponed annotations, determine subsequent transitions; unusable annotations raise `PipelineAnnotationError`, a `StrategyPipelineError`, with the zero-based declaration index and direction. Field metadata, active dialects, configured dialects, class configuration, and codec defaults select whole pipelines according to existing strategy precedence. Generated unpacking preserves established required-field, default, nullable, and alias behavior around the reversed conversion. Each field, generated class, codec instance, and schema build has isolated callable and recursion state, even when pipelines or stateful strategies are reused.
